name: Theoretical Computer Science
notes: Only available to students studying Bachelor of Advanced Computing (AACOM) and Bachelor of Advanced Computing Research & Development (AACRD).
MATH4343 requires a permission code from the course convener.
COMP4011 Advanced Topics in Formal Methods and Programming Languages is a special topics course; the topic varies by offering.
COMP3630 is also compulsory in AACOM; since a course is never counted twice, AACOM students cannot count it towards this specialisation.
COMP4712 sits in the page's lower 'maximum of 12 units' list even though it is 4000-level, so it counts towards the 4000-level minimum but not towards the 12 units required from the first list.

COMP4011.title: Advanced Topics in Formal Methods and Programming Languages

requirements.label: At least 12 units from the 4000-level list
Remaining 12 units from either list (at most 12 from the lower-level list)
requirements.note: The page's 'maximum of 12 units' from this list is implied: with at least 12 units required from the 4000-level list, at most 12 units of the 24 can come from here.
